events.text: The Eastern Army Division was disbanded as a result of the disarmament policies set forward in the Defence Act of 2000.

events.text: The Eastern Army Division was raised on 1 August 1941 as the IV Division.

events.text: The mobilization responsibility for the division was transferred to the Göta Life Guards in 1957.

events.text: The mobilization responsibility for the division was transferred to the Uppland Regiment in 1970.

events.text: The division's designation was changed to the 4th Division (4. fördelningen) on 1 October 1966.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 1 October 1966, the designation was changed from being given in Roman numerals to Arabic numerals

events.text: The army division came to be subordinate to the military commander of the Middle Military District on 1 July 1991.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 1 July 1991, the Bergslagen Military District and the Eastern Military District merged and formed the Middle Military District

events.text: The army division staff came to be organized as cadre-organized units within the Middle Military District on 1 July 1994.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: As of 1 July 1994, the army division staff, together with the Middle Army Division, came to be organized

events.text: The three army division staffs were disbanded on 30 June 2000.

events.text: The two staffs were moved to the barracks of the Life Regiment of Horse (K 1) at Lidingövägen 28 in Stockholm in 1949.

events.quote: In 1949, the two staffs were moved to the barracks of the Life Regiment of Horse (K 1) at Lidingövägen 28 in Stockholm

events.text: Both staff were transferred to a new property complex in Strängnäs Garrison on 14 June 1963.

events.text: The staff was located in Strängnäs Garrison in various forms until 2005.
